title: django-allauth-jwt-template
subtitle: Django Authentication Template
description: Email, Google, Microsoft and LINE login for SPAs and APIs, using django-allauth’s headless mode and built-in JWTs.
longDescription: A Django authentication template built on django-allauth headless mode and its built-in JWT support. It demonstrates email and social login for separate frontends, with end-to-end verification rather than a custom session-to-JWT bridge.
features: Headless authentication with built-in JWT support
Email, Google, Microsoft and LINE login
results: Authentication template built on django-allauth’s supported headless interfaces
